AI Business Partner - Activation

Role Overview

The AI Business Partner translates business priorities into practical AI solutions that improve how work gets done. Sitting at the intersection of business strategy, domain expertise, and applied AI, this role identifies high-value opportunities, builds working prototypes and pilots, and partners cross-functionally to scale successful solutions.

This Partner will be aligned to Activation, a portfolio that spans media, social, content, creator/influencer/Starpower, and omnichannel. The work will vary across these areas and will be conducted in partnership with the designated business and discipline leads. Discipline leaders own business strategy, workflow priorities, functional requirements, stakeholder alignment and adoption within their respective capabilities. The Activation AI Business Partner brings applied AI and technical expertise to assess feasibility, prototype solutions, support operationalization and scale validated capabilities across Activation. The right person is comfortable moving between distinct disciplines with different maturity levels, tooling and ways of working, and can sequence where to focus first.

This role is ideal for someone who can move fluidly from ambiguity to action — working with stakeholders to define problems, rapidly testing ideas using modern generative AI tools, and helping the organization adopt AI in ways that are useful, responsible, and aligned with business needs.

Key Responsibilities

AI Opportunity Identification & Prioritization

  • Partner with business and discipline leaders to identify high-value opportunities to apply generative AI across workflows, deliverables, and business processes.
  • Translate business priorities, functional requirements and user needs defined with discipline leaders into clearly scoped AI use cases, pilots, and solution concepts.
  • Assess opportunities based on business value, technical feasibility, user needs, adoption potential, scalability and risk.
  • Partner with discipline leaders  to prioritize opportunities within individual capabilities and help sequence initiatives  across the broader Activation portfolio.
  • Maintain visibility across the Activation AI opportunity pipeline to identify shared needs, reusable components, dependencies and opportunities for cross-discipline scale

 

Prototyping & Solution Development

  • Build and iterate on working prototypes, pilots, and lightweight AI-enabled tools in response to business priorities and functional requirements established with business and discipline leads using modern development environments, LLM APIs, agentic workflows, and related technologies.
  • Design prompts, workflows, and tool interactions that guide AI behavior toward accurate, useful, and contextually relevant outcomes.
  • Test solutions quickly with representative users and discipline subject matter experts, incorporate user feedback, and refine prototypes based on real-world usage and evolving requirements.
  • Move ideas from concept to demonstrable value, balancing speed, practicality, technical feasibility, quality and responsible AI requirements.
  • Provide technical consultation during discovery to help discipline leaders distinguish between workflow, process, data, platform and AI-related needs

 

Cross-Functional Delivery & Scaling

  • Own the technical progression of validated concepts from discovery through prototype, pilot, handoff and scaling, in partnership with the appropriate teams (i.e., platform, data, security, governance teams, etc.)
  • Partner closely with AI technical teams, engineering, product, and business stakeholders to transition validated prototypes into scalable, production-ready solutions where appropriate.

Adoption, Enablement & Change Management

  • Partner with discipline leaders to support successful adoption of AI solutions through solution-specific guidance, training, onboarding materials, and usage playbooks.

  • Foster a culture of experimentation, continuous learning, and practical innovation.

 

Governance, Quality & Responsible AI

  • Help ensure AI solutions are designed and applied in ways that are responsible, compliant, and appropriate for a regulated healthcare communications environment.
  • Incorporate considerations related to privacy, safety, quality, transparency, and human oversight into solution design and rollout.
  • Partner with relevant stakeholders to align AI use with organizational standards, governance expectations, and evolving best practices.
  • Promote thoughtful experimentation while maintaining appropriate safeguards and quality controls.

 

Domain Expertise Application

  • Apply working knowledge strong understanding of healthcare communications, including advertising, activation, communications, and medical domains, to shape relevant and impactful AI solutions.
  • Apply working knowledge of and demonstrate fluency in paid media, social, and influencer marketing — including the platforms, buying and measurement mechanics, and campaign workflows that drive day-to-day execution.

Qualifications

Since our founding in 2008 we have grown continuously and are today part of Gamma Communications. Together we are changing the way people work around the world. Today and in the future. Tasks Your role As Growth Marketing Manager – Automation you own the automated systems that carry a user from first signup through activation to expansion – and the CRM and AI infrastructure underneath them. Our growth model is self-service and low-touch by design. That only works if the machine behind it is genuinely good. HubSpot sits at the centre of that machine, connected to product usage data, billing and our web and trial funnel. Your job is to make it do more, do it automatically, and do it with AI agents built natively into the flow – not bolted on as an afterthought. We are deliberately open on the shape of this role. There are two ways to be excellent at it, and we will build the role around whichever one you bring. What you will do – the core Own our marketing and sales automation stack, with HubSpot (Marketing + Sales Hub) at the centre and clean connections to product, billing, website and trial funnel. Design, build and continuously improve automated journeys across the whole lifecycle: trial onboarding, activation nudges, lead scoring and routing, upsell and cross-sell, win-back and churn prevention. Replace manual processes with automation – every recurring task a human does today is a candidate, in marketing and in sales. Build AI agents into the funnel natively: qualification, enrichment, routing, response drafting, content generation. Not just AI features inside HubSpot. Keep our data trustworthy: lifecycle stages, attribution and product-usage signals flowing reliably between systems. Measure what you build – every journey has a metric, a baseline and an iteration plan. Work closely with Sales, Product, Growth Analytics and eCommerce, and make their work easier by removing manual steps from it. Two possible focus areas – pick yours You should be strong in one of these and comfortable in the other . Tell us in your application which one is yours. Focus A – Technical / AI Automation You architect HubSpot rather than just operate it: data model, custom objects and properties, APIs, webhooks, integrations. You build automations beyond HubSpot too – with workflow tools (n8n, Make, Zapier) and with LLM and agent frameworks. You are comfortable with APIs, JSON and enough Python or JavaScript to ship something yourself instead of queueing behind engineering. You have already built working agentic automations, not just prototyped with a chat interface. Focus B – Lifecycle & Content Automation You own the content inside the journeys: onboarding series, activation emails, in-product messaging, nurture and reactivation tracks. You write German copy that sounds like a person wrote it, not a workflow – and you use AI to produce more of it, faster, without losing that. You design journeys around real user behaviour and know which message at which moment actually moves the metric. You are relentless about testing subject lines, timing, triggers and sequencing. Requirements Who we are looking for Several years in marketing and sales automation, lifecycle marketing, marketing ops or CRM – ideally in B2B SaaS with a self-service or product-led motion. Deep, hands-on HubSpot experience: workflows, custom properties and objects, lists, lifecycle stages, reporting. You know where its limits are and how to work around them. Clear strength in one of the two focus areas above and solid working knowledge of the other. Genuine curiosity about AI agents and automation – you have already built things with LLMs, not only read about them. Analytical and structured, with a low tolerance for manual, repetitive processes. Fluent German and English. Our customers are German SMBs and much of the journey content is in German. Self-starter who can carry several topics in parallel and finish them. Experience migrating or rebuilding a CRM setup rather than only maintaining one. Benefits What we offer A genuinely central role: what you automate defines how our whole growth motion scales. Freedom to choose your tools and to build AI-native rather than retrofitting. A young, ambitious team of marketing, product and tech experts with a real growth mentality. Hybrid working model with flexible hours and a genuine remote culture – we care about output, not attendance. Extensive learning and development opportunities across growth, SaaS and AI. Central office location in Cologne’s Südstadt, modern workspaces and high-quality equipment. Water, coffee and fresh fruit included. Open, collegial company culture with regular team events. POSITION SUMMARY:  On site position in Pleasanton, CA

Clinical Data Operator accessions patient samples according to standard operating procedures (SOP) with high efficiency and accuracy.
 
Shift: Tuesday - Saturday, Day Shift 630am-3pm.  Hourly rate starts at $21.77.

  • Create new orders on Laboratory Inventory Management System (LIMS) and perform necessary checks to ensure proper accessioning.
  • Accession samples with high accuracy and efficiency.

  • Protect patient health information (PHI) at all times to ensure compliance with HIPAA and privacy policies.
  • Perform safe and proper handling of samples (blood, buccal, and tissue).

title: PLOS One Associate Editor - Life Sciences
description:
*This position is fully remote/home based. Applications will be accepted from candidates based in the UK and the following US states: FL, IL, MA, MD, NY, PA, TX, VA.

 In the US, this is a union represented position as part of the Pacific Media Workers Guild, Local 39521 of the NewsGuild-Communication Workers of America. 

Role Summary 

PLOS is a nonprofit organization on a mission to drive open science forward with measurable, meaningful change in research publishing, policy, and practice. We believe in a better future where science is open to all, for all.  

 The Associate Editor oversees the editorial process for manuscripts submitted to PLOS journals. This role will require the use of prior research experience, critical evaluation skills, and internal guidelines to make nuanced and complex editorial decisions. The Associate Editor works with colleagues in their division and other teams to deliver developmental and promotional activities for PLOS journals. 

 

Responsibilities 

  • Serve as a point of escalation for complex and nuanced editorial queries. 
  • Support other teams at PLOS, members of the editorial board, and third-party editorial teams to ensure high standards of scientific rigor and editorial integrity are upheld. 
  • Evaluate submissions and make decisions based on reviewers’ comments. 
  • Participate in activities to develop editorial policy and improve the visibility and reputation of journals in the PLOS portfolio. 
  • Handle publication ethics queries. 
  • Build relationships with members of the academic community. 
  • Demonstrate a positive, constructive attitude to change and a growth mindset. 

 

Knowledge and Skills 

  • Experience in a research environment, publishing, or other relevant industry. 
  • Highly organized and efficient, with strong critical assessment, and problem-solving abilities. 
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, both written and oral. 
  • Able to work under tight deadlines whilst achieving a high standard of quality and accuracy. 
  • Able to set priorities and work independently. 

 

Qualifications 

  • A PhD is required. 

 

Physical Requirements and Work Environment 

  • Prolonged periods stationary at a desk and working on a computer 
  • Some national and international travel may be required occasionally 
  • Some flexibility to work across time zones 

 

The base salary range we’ve established for these positions is (UK) £35,000 - £38,950 / (US) $67000 to $73,625. PLOS also offers a comprehensive benefits package summarized below.  

 

BENEFITS: 

US:

  • 401k with employer match
  • Employee sponsored health, dental and vision insurance (Dental and Vision 100% employer paid)
  • Paid Vacation, 11 public holidays and sick leave
  • Parental leave
  • Birthday and three winter holidays days off
  • Short term and long term disability insurance
  • 2 days paid time off for volunteering per year
  • Fully remote work environment with stipend on joining for home office 

UK: 

  • Private medical insurance 
  • Life assurance 
  • Income protection  
  • Personal accident insurance 
  • Pension with up to 10% employer match 
  • 25 days holidays, market competitive Maternity and Paternity leave 
  • Birthday and three winter holidays days off 
  • 2 days paid time off for volunteering per year 
  • Fully remote work environment with stipend on joining for home office

About PLOS 

Building on a strong legacy of pioneering innovation, PLOS continues to be a catalyst in open science, reimagining models to meet open science principles, removing barriers and promoting inclusion in knowledge creation and sharing, and publishing research outputs that enable everyone to learn from, reuse and build upon scientific knowledge.

Our work is supported by a highly skilled global in-house team, partnerships with local scholarly organizations, and the valued contributions of a diverse, international community of scientific researchers.

We’re committed to equal opportunity

We’re working to create a more equitable system of scientific knowledge and understanding. Removing barriers to inclusion and facilitating broad participation of voices is core to our success, inside and out. 

Beyond accepting distinct perspectives, we seek and support divergent backgrounds among our staff because we know differences strengthen our teams, our work, and our communities. We strongly encourage applicants of all identities to join us as we work towards a future where science is open to all, for all. 

Visit plos.org/careers to learn more.

To learn more about how PLOS protects your privacy, see our Employee Privacy Notice.

title: Data Scientist
description:
About us

PhysicsX is a deep-tech company with roots in numerical physics and Formula One, dedicated to accelerating hardware innovation at the speed of software.
We are building an AI-driven simulation software stack for engineering and manufacturing across advanced industries. By enabling high-fidelity, multi-physics simulation through AI inference across the entire engineering lifecycle, PhysicsX unlocks new levels of optimization and automation in design, manufacturing, and operations — empowering engineers to push the boundaries of possibility. Our customers include leading innovators in Aerospace & Defense, Materials, Energy, Semiconductors, and Automotive.
 

Who We're Looking For

As a Data Scientist in Delivery, you are a problem solver and builder who is passionate about creating practical solutions that enable customers to make better engineering decisions. You are someone who can grasp advanced engineering concepts across multiple industries, and you excel at working directly with customers (and often side-by-side with them on-site) to transform cutting edge AI models into tools that are useful and used.
 
You’ve worked on difficult problems that require strong foundations in data driven modelling and deep learning techniques, with hands-on experience in probabilistic methods and predictive modelling. Expertise in python, along with proficiency in libraries like NumPy, SciPy, Pandas, TensorFlow and PyTorch, is essential, with the ability to deploy scalable, production-ready models and data pipelines.
 
With at least 1 year industry experience (post Masters or PhD) in a commercial, non-research environment, you’re ready to hit the ground running. You’re truly excited about growing your technical expertise and are naturally inclined to take ownership of data science work streams, continuously improving the systems and solutions you work on to ensure they are practical, impactful and meet the evolving needs of our customers.
 

This Role

In this role, you’ll work closely with our Simulation Engineers, Machine Learning Engineers, and customers to understand and define the engineering and physics challenges we are solving.
You’ll build the foundations for successful, impactful solutions by:
 
  • Pre-processing and analyzing data to prepare it for use in predictive modelling, building the foundation for machine learning algorithms to be developed.
  • Developing and utilizing innovative deep learning models in combination with state-of-the-art optimization methods to predict and control the behaviour of physical systems.
  • Taking full responsibility for the quality, accuracy and impact of your work.
  • Designing, building and testing data pipelines that are reliable, scalable and easily deployable in production environments.
  • Working closely with simulation engineers to ensure seamless integration of data science models with simulations.
  • Contributing to internal R&D and product development, helping to refine models and identify new areas of application.
  • Engaging in open communication and presentation with both technical teams and customers, helping onboard users and co-develop with customers.

You'll also have the opportunity to travel to customer sites in North America, Europe, Asia, Oceania, for an average of 3-4 weeks per quarter, where you'll collaborate closely with customers to build solutions on-site.

As the role evolves, there are exciting opportunities for growth as an individual contributor or a technical lead, especially if you’re driven by taking ownership of more complex projects and leading the direction of future solutions.
Please note, this role is based in London, working 2-3 days per week in our central office.
 

Our delivery teams drive innovation to turn AI models into practical solutions - read our blog to learn more about how you’ll contribute to this exciting journey!

 

What we offer

Build what actually matters

Help shape an AI-native engineering company at a formative stage, tackling problems that genuinely matter for industry and society. This is work with real-world impact - and something you can be proud to stand behind.

Learn alongside exceptional people

Work with a high-caliber, collaborative team of engineers, scientists, and operators who care deeply about doing great work, and about helping each other get better. We come from diverse backgrounds, but we share a commitment to operating at the highest level and addressing some of the most complex challenges out there. If you’re ambitious, thoughtful, and driven by impact, you’ll feel at home.

Influence over hierarchy

We operate with a flat structure: good ideas win - wherever they come from. Questioning assumptions and challenging the status quo isn’t just welcomed, it’s expected.

Sustainable pace, long-term ambition

Building meaningful technology is a marathon, not a sprint. We believe in balancing focused, ambitious work with a life beyond it. Our hybrid model blends time together in our Shoreditch office with work-from-home days, giving you the flexibility to work sustainably while staying connected in person.

And it doesn’t stop there …

title: Lab Operations Manager
description: About Substrate Substrate is the critical infrastructure layer between AI and biology. AI for biology has a data problem, not a compute problem: biological foundation models can predict but cannot experiment, and the large-scale, high-quality data they need does not exist. We are building the lab that generates it, with quality and provenance built in. We are not a CRO and we are not a cloud lab. The company was founded by Mostafa ElSayed, co-founder and CEO; Oli Hoy, who leads the lab buildout and operations; Alexey Morgunov, who leads science and intelligence software; and Anna Huyghues-Despointes, who leads partnerships and go-to-market. The role You will run the day-to-day operations of our lab in London, and be the person the scientists come to when something is missing, broken, late or lost. The day-one work is what you would expect: consumables and stock, goods in and cold chain, equipment servicing and calibration, suppliers and purchasing, waste streams and safety records. Three parts go beyond a standard lab operations job. The first is provenance. Every experiment we sell carries a record of what went into it, down to the lot of the consumable used and the conditions material was held in. If a lot number is not captured, the data point is worth less, and that record runs through you. The second is that the systems are not written yet. Inventory, goods in, asset registers and ordering exist in no form that will survive the next year. You define what the lab has to capture and work with the science and software teams to make sure it does. The third is that sample handling and stock control here get automated, and you help specify the system that does it. Every sample, plate, reagent and consumable lot carries a barcode, scanned at each point it is handled, so the record is created by the work rather than reconstructed afterwards. The same scan draws stock down, which turns reordering from a weekly count into something the system flags before anyone is short. Our software team is building that layer now and the requirements have to come from the lab floor: what gets a barcode, where the scan points sit, and what happens when a label will not read. Some find that energising; some find it outside their lane. Worth knowing which one you are. Your first 90 days First 30 days Take ownership of goods in: every delivery received, booked in, stored correctly and recorded. Map how material moves through the lab and build the first accurate picture of what we hold. That map is the input to a fully barcoded scheme and system. Days 30 to 60 Put a working inventory and reorder system in place, with minimum levels set from real consumption rather than guesses, and own the purchasing loop. Agree the barcode and labelling scheme with the software team, and get equipment records in one place. Days 60 to 90 Run the lab as a routine that does not depend on being asked, with the barcoded system live across one workflow, goods-in to bench to stock draw-down, feeding our provenance record. Who you are You have run the physical side of a lab where being out of stock stops the work: biotech, pharma, a university or institute lab, or a manufacturing or diagnostics operation built around one. Lab consumables and the rhythm of a working lab are already familiar to you, you have handled real volume and real inventory, and you know the difference between a system that works on paper and one that works at eight on a Monday morning. We are not asking for a particular speciality, but you should arrive able to run the lab rather than learn what one needs. Must have: Two or more years running a lab or comparable physical operation, hands-on and accountable for the result. Practical stock control: goods in, inventory records, reorder points, stock counts that reconcile. Buying from suppliers: raising orders, comparing quotes, managing lead times. Hands-on with a barcoded or scanned stock system, including what goes wrong when people skip the scan. Lab environment experience: cold storage, hazardous waste, containment, controlled materials. Nice to have: Health and safety training such as IOSH. Developed or co-developed a barcode system for autonomous workflows in labs, including working with software development teams to implement it. How we work and who you will work with This role is on site five days a week at 20 Triton Street in London, because the lab is a physical place and the work is in it. The wider founding team is distributed across London, New York and Europe. You will report to Simon Varzandeh, a member of our scientific staff working on protein characterisation and one of the lab's heaviest users, and work alongside the protein science and functional genomics teams, the engineers building the tracking and stock system with you, and operations on facilities, health and safety and purchasing. You will be the first person here whose whole job is focused on the lab floor. We work in the open and each person owns their area. UK benefits are 30 days of annual leave plus public holidays, a pension with a 10% employer contribution, and top-tier Bupa private health cover. Our process and how to apply Four stages: a short screening call; a conversation about how you work, before anything technical; a practical exercise from our lab setup, sent separately, then a discussion of what you did and why; then references. We are sharing this role through our network first. Send a note and your CV to ----- and if you are not sure whether you are a fit, send it anyway. Substrate is an equal opportunity employer. We make hiring decisions on merit, scope-fit, and the strength of the working relationship we expect to build with each hire. Applications welcome from candidates of any background.  AvePoint is seeking a highly analytical Data Analyst to support and scale our global partner business. We are seeking a highly motivated, analytical, and innovative Scientist II to join our Platform Discovery team.   • Lead the development, evaluation, and benchmarking of innovative non-viral methods for nucleic acid donor template delivery for recombinase-based large gene insertion
  • Design and execute hypothesis-driven experiments to identify and overcome barriers to donor template stability, intracellular trafficking, and nuclear availability
  • Develop quantitative assays to evaluate donor template delivery and connect these measurements to targeted insertion efficiency and fidelity
  • Analyze data to drive critical go/no-go decisions, clearly present conclusions and rationale to stakeholders across the organization
  • Collaborate with downstream translational teams to validate recombinase donor template delivery approaches in therapeutically relevant cell-based and in vivo systems.

  • Provide mentorship and guidance to junior team members and peers, helping align goals, troubleshoot experiments, and maintain high standards for execution and interpretation

  • Demonstrated ability to develop mechanistic cell-based assays and troubleshoot complex biological systems
  • Deep understanding of the barriers and challenges surrounding nucleic acid delivery in mammalian cells and therapeutic applications
  • Strong hands-on experience in molecular cloning, nucleic acid construct design, and mammalian cell engineering
  • Extensive hands-on experience and deep understanding of NGS-based assays for evaluating genome editing outcomes
  • Proven track record of independently and successfully leading multifaceted research projects

Preferences

  • Experience with process automation and scaling to develop high throughput workflows, ideally in a biotechnology/industry research setting

title: Consultant
description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
 
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
 
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
 
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.


The Role
Veeva Systems, a leader in cloud-based solutions for the global life sciences industry, is looking for a Project Management Consultant to join our Clinical Data Professional Services team. Veeva’s Clinical Data Suite includes EDC (Electronic Data Capture), Coder, DQS (Data Quality System), and other applications.
 
The Project Management Consultant will be responsible for managing project teams who implement Veeva Clinical Data Software with focus on maintaining timelines, budgets, deliverables, and overseeing customer adoption. This role requires attention to detail, communication, organization, problem-solving and software implementation skills. Days and hours of work are generally Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM, however hours are dependent on customer needs and deliverables.
 #LI-Remote #LI-Associate Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world. Veeva is an equal opportunity employer. title: Market Data Analyst Metals & Minerals
description: At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors. Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 700 experts from 35+ countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success. Your future position: Kpler’s Dry Bulk business unit is expanding its footprint in the Metals & Minerals sector. We are looking for a Market Data Analyst to take ownership of data quality and operational processes across ferrous and non-ferrous metals, solid fuels, and industrial minerals. This is a role for someone who wants to sit close to how global commodity markets actually move. You will combine strong SQL and Python skills with a curiosity about the real-world events shaping those movements - from shifting trade flows and supply chain disruptions to changes in industrial demand, policy, and pricing dynamics. You won’t just be processing data. You will play a key role in turning complex, high-volume datasets into reliable market intelligence used by clients to understand what is happening in global physical markets. Your work will directly influence how accurately we reflect real-world commodity flows. As the team grows, you will also help mentor junior analysts and act as a bridge between raw data, market developments, and the insights our clients depend on to make decisions. Your mission is to: Take charge of specific regions and product groups, ensuring the highest standard of data quality by reviewing internal constraints, validating automated outputs, and ingesting data from diverse external sources. Identify and implement technology and process improvements – including contributions to SQL queries, Python scripts, and pipeline tooling – to increase the efficiency and accuracy of our seaborne flow data. Track news, trade flows, and industry developments across metals and minerals markets. Extract meaningful patterns and ensure they are well reflected in our data product. Lead responses to ad-hoc client requests (email, video call, in-person) with rapid, well-structured analysis. Partner with Sales and Customer Success teams to address client data needs and feed insights back into internal systems. Engage proactively with the broader data architecture; understand how upstream data sources, internal systems, and client-facing solutions interact, and propose improvements that scale across the team. Act as a knowledgeable and self-directed team member capable of picking up complex technical tasks independently and driving them to completion with minimal supervision. You could be a match if you are or have: Proven experience working with large, complex datasets within commodities, shipping, logistics, supply chains, or related physical markets. Strong proficiency in SQL and Python (PostgreSQL, MSSQL, or similar) is a core requirement. You use both to query databases, analyse data, and automate workflows, building and maintaining scripts to remove manual processes and improve efficiency. Strong Excel skills are required for analysis and commercial reporting. Demonstrated understanding of commodity markets and the commercial drivers behind physical data. You are naturally curious about market developments, trade flows, supply and demand dynamics, and global events influencing commodity movements, and you seek to understand both what changed and why it changed when investigating anomalies. Comfortable managing high-frequency datasets, identifying anomalies, and maintaining high standards of data quality under tight deadlines. Strong communicator, able to translate complex technical outputs into clear, actionable insights for both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and build effective relationships across teams. Proactive and self-directed: takes ownership, anticipates issues, and drives work independently to completion. title: Graduate / Junior Data Scientist
description:
About THG Ingenuity

THG Ingenuity is a fully integrated digital commerce ecosystem, designed to power brands without limits. Our global end-to-end tech platform is comprised of three products: THG Commerce, THG Studios, THG Fulfilment. 

Each represents a single, unified solution, overcoming challenges and taking brands direct-to-consumer. Our client portfolio includes globally recognised brands such as Coca-Cola, Nestle, Elemis, Homebase, and Proctor & Gamble.

The Role

We are seeking a talented and commercially astute Data Scientist to join our dynamic team tackling Fraud, Payments and Finance. In this multi-focus role, you will be responsible for protecting our global e-commerce operations from fraud, optimising our payments performance and driving profitability and automation initiatives within Finance.

Working with vast, complex datasets, the work will involve combatting online fraud using our award-winning THG Detect platform and driving payments optimisation by increasing authorisation rates, while also using the latest AI software and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) infrastructure to build complex data solutions and applications.

This role requires a blend of strong technical skills, commercial acumen, and effective communication to translate complex data insights into tangible business value.

Responsibilities:

  • Optimise Fraud Detection: Continuously improve automated decision-making in our in-house THG Detect platform using machine learning and decision rules.
  • Enhance Payment Performance: Lead data-driven initiatives to boost payment authorisation rates, optimise transaction routing, and reduce costs.
  • Drive Profitability within Finance: Lead automation and profitability initiatives across different areas of Finance.
  • Communicate Performance: Report on all aspects of fraud, payments and finance performance to stakeholders at all levels, including C-level management.
  • Drive System Improvements: Collaborate with Fraud, Payments, Finance and Engineering teams to scope and implement enhancements to detection systems and data pipelines.
  • Innovate & Automate: Proactively identify opportunities to improve detection capabilities, drive profitability, increase payment success, and enhance team efficiency through automation.

Requirements:

  • Proficient with SQL & Python
  • Proficient in a data visualisation software (Tableau/Looker/PowerBI/e.t.c.)
  • Experience using a variety of machine learning algorithms
  • Able to communicate effectively; using data to tell a story and drive business change
  • Experience within Google Cloud preferential

title: Product Engineer (m/w/d)
description: Warum LPE Immobilien? Die Hausverwaltung ist der unterschätzteste Beruf Deutschlands: Kein anderer entscheidet so unmittelbar darüber, wie Menschen wohnen. Trotzdem gilt der Hausverwalter bis heute als Buchhalter mit Schlüsselbund. Wir wollen das ändern, und Software ist dafür einer unserer zentralen Hebel. Mit lpeOS bauen wir die Systeme, mit denen wir selbst jeden Tag arbeiten: das Kundenportal für unsere Eigentümer, KI-Agenten, die eigenständig Aufgaben übernehmen, und das Verwaltercockpit als Arbeitsumgebung unserer Verwalter. Wir digitalisieren unsere eigenen Prozesse, um die Arbeit unserer Verwalter jeden Tag ein Stück besser zu machen, mit dem Anspruch, die Branche zu revolutionieren. Kaum eine Branche wurde von moderner Software so lange übersehen. Der Abstand zwischen dem, was ist, und dem, was möglich ist, ist riesig, und wir bauen ihn Stück für Stück zu. Du wärst eine der ersten Personen im Produktteam. Was dich bei uns erwartet – Deine Aufgaben Du entwickelst Fullstack in TypeScript , vom Kundenportal über das Verwaltercockpit bis zu den Services und der Infrastruktur dahinter, auf der grünen Wiese und ohne Altlasten. Features verantwortest du end-to-end: von der Idee über die Gestaltung bis zum Release, bei Bedarf auch ohne Designer an deiner Seite. Du baust KI-Agenten als Produktfunktionalität für unsere Verwalter und Kunden. Zugleich entwickeln wir unsere eigene Entwicklungsumgebung permanent weiter: ein modernes Setup rund um Cursor und Claude Code, inklusive Agent-Graph-Loops und Harness. Dabei arbeitest du nah an den Nutzern : Deine Kolleginnen, Kollegen und Kunden sind direkt erreichbar, Feedback bekommst du auf kurzem und direktem Weg. Wir sammeln Probleme, bewerten sie und bauen die wichtigsten in festen Cycles. Unser Stack : TypeScript durchgehend, mit React und Next.js im Frontend und Node im Backend, als Monorepo auf Google Cloud (Infrastructure as Code), dazu Postgres und event-getriebene Prozesse. Du musst nicht alles davon kennen, den Rest lernst du bei uns. Was du mitbringen solltest 2 bis 4 Jahre Erfahrung in der Webentwicklung. Sichere Praxis in TypeScript oder JavaScript, idealerweise mit React oder Next.js. Ein aktuelles Projekt, das du zeigen kannst: Produktionscode, Side Project oder Open Source. Du arbeitest gern quer über den ganzen Stack und magst Frontend und Backend ähnlich gern. Du verantwortest Features end-to-end und kannst bei Bedarf auch ohne Designer ein gutes Interface gestalten. KI-Tooling ist Teil deines Arbeitsalltags, und du prüfst die Ergebnisse genauso kritisch, wie du sie nutzt. Grundverständnis von Datenbanken (SQL) und API-Design. Du willst verstehen, warum etwas gebaut wird, bevor du es baust. Deutschkenntnisse mindestens auf B2-Niveau. Du erfüllst nicht alle Punkte? Bewirb dich trotzdem. Talent und Lernkurve zählen bei uns mehr als Jahreszahlen im Lebenslauf. Was wir dir bieten Eine seltene Ausgangslage. Wir bauen Software für ein Geschäftsmodell, das bereits funktioniert, und wissen, dass sie gebraucht wird. Du erlebst aus nächster Nähe, wie sich eine ganze Branche neu erfindet, und gestaltest das aktiv mit. Echter Impact. Alles, was du baust, kommt bei unseren Verwaltern, Eigentümern und Kunden direkt zum Einsatz. Eine Branche von innen kennenlernen. Die Immobilienwirtschaft ist einer der größten Märkte Deutschlands und steht erst am Anfang ihrer Digitalisierung. Du lernst sie dort kennen, wo die Entscheidungen fallen. Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit den Produktverantwortlichen. Kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheidungen und jemand, der sich Zeit für deine Fragen nimmt. Mentoring und Weiterentwicklung. Wohin du dich entwickeln willst, besprechen wir offen und regelmäßig. Mentoring ist bei uns in alle Richtungen möglich, fachlich wie persönlich. Ehrliches Feedback. Sofort und in beide Richtungen. Die richtigen Werkzeuge. Premium-Hardware, cloudbasierte Tools, aktuelles KI-Tooling, papierlos. Wenn dir etwas fehlt, um besser zu arbeiten, bekommst du es. Perspektive. title: Bilingual Content Creator, Khan Academy Kids (24 months fixed-term)

description:
Notice to applicants:

We have seen a rise in recruitment scams. Please note that outreach from Khan Academy recruiters will only come from the @khanacademy.org domain. Our team does not use Gmail or other personal accounts for contacting potential candidates. Khan Academy will never solicit money, equipment fees, or sensitive financial information at any stage of the hiring process. We also do not work with external recruiting agencies, so outreach from headhunters presenting opportunities on behalf of Khan Academy is illegitimate. Please always check the email domain and cross-reference the position with the official Khan Academy Careers page to confirm an opening is valid.

ABOUT KHAN ACADEMY

Khan Academy is a nonprofit with the mission to deliver a free, world-class education to anyone, anywhere. Our proven learning platform offers free, high-quality supplemental learning content and practice that cover Pre-K - 12th grade and early college core academic subjects, focusing on math and science. We have over 181 million registered learners globally and are committed to improving learning outcomes for students worldwide, focusing on learners in historically under-resourced communities.

ABOUT KHAN ACADEMY KIDS

Khan Academy Kids is a free and fun learning program for children ages 2 to 8. Kodi Bear and a cast of animated characters lead children on a personalized education journey filled with fun, standards-aligned activities in early literacy, math, executive functioning and social emotional skills. Built by a small but mighty team, Khan Academy Kids is used by millions of children in homes and classrooms around the world. 

OUR COMMUNITY 

Our students, teachers, and parents come from all walks of life, and so do we. Our team includes people from academia, traditional/non-traditional education, big tech companies, and tiny startups. We hire great people from diverse backgrounds and experiences because it makes our company stronger. We value diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging as necessary to achieve our mission and impact the communities we serve. We know that transforming education starts in-house with learning about ourselves and our colleagues. We strive to be world-class in investing in our people and commit to developing you as a professional.

THE ROLE

Khan Academy Kids is looking for an early childhood educator and learning-content developer to build and strengthen learning activities and assessments for children in PreK through 2nd grade.

Working on a small, interdisciplinary team alongside product managers, engineers, designers, and academic experts, the Content Creator will identify gaps in our content library, create and revise learning experiences in English and Spanish, and improve the systems that support content development. Content spans bilingual (English and Spanish) learning activities and direct assessments across early literacy, language, math, and executive function.

We are looking for someone who understands how young children learn, is energized by using data to make content better, and cares deeply about making early learning both rigorous and fun. 

This is a fixed-term position with an expected term of 24 months.

Responsibilities:

  • Author high-quality, standards-aligned learning activities and assessment items in English and Spanish for PreK through 2nd grade, using subject-matter expertise and knowledge of early-learning standards (e.g., Head Start ELOF, Common Core, state PreK standards)
  • Map content coverage across the Khan Academy Kids library, building crosswalks that connect practice activities to assessments and identifying gaps in coverage
  • Revise and improve existing assessments based on direct child assessment data and psychometric analyses
  • Author and test new assessment items with children and educators in classroom settings
  • Learn and leverage Khan Academy Kids' content-authoring infrastructure, and partner with product and engineering to improve authoring tooling and workflows
  • Coordinate with creative teams on asset and audio requests, and improve audio-generation and quality-assurance processes
  • Serve as an editorial reviewer for new and existing content in both English and Spanish

WHAT YOU BRING

  • 2+ years of experience developing educational content or teaching, ideally with children in preschool through second grade. Experience with early childhood assessment (item development, administration, or play-testing) is a strong plus.
  • Full professional fluency and strong writing and editing skills in English and Spanish, with mindfulness of dialectal variation in both languages. Must be able to create, edit, and adapt developmentally appropriate content while preserving meaning, tone, and cultural relevance across languages. Note that Spanish proficiency will be assessed during the hiring process.
  • Experience working with early-learning standards (e.g., Head Start ELOF, Common Core, state PreK frameworks) and ensuring alignment and coverage
  • Comfort using data and learner feedback to evaluate, prioritize, and improve content
  • Comfort learning technical systems and working with structured content, including experience with or a willingness to learn JSON and SQL
  • Experience collaborating with colleagues across product, engineering, design, research, creative, and academic teams
  • Strong project-management and organizational skills, with close attention to detail
  • Motivated by the Khan Academy mission “to provide a free world-class education for anyone, anywhere."
  • Proven cross-cultural competency skills demonstrating self-awareness, awareness of other, and the ability to adopt inclusive perspectives, attitudes, and behaviors to drive inclusion and belonging throughout the organization.

PERKS AND BENEFITS

We may be a non-profit, but we reward our talented team extremely well! We offer:

  • Competitive salaries
  • Ample paid time off as needed – Your well-being is a priority
  • 8 pre-scheduled Wellness Days in 2026 occurring on a Monday or a Friday for a 3-day weekend boost
  • Remote-first culture - that caters to your time zone, with open flexibility as needed, at times
  • Generous parental leave
  • An exceptional team that trusts you and gives you the freedom to do your best
  • The chance to put your talents towards a deeply meaningful mission and the opportunity to work on high-impact products that are already defining the future of education
  • Opportunities to connect through affinity, ally, and social groups
  • And we offer all those other typical benefits as well: 401(k) + 4% matching & comprehensive insurance, including medical, dental, vision, and life

At Khan Academy we are committed to fair and equitable compensation practices, the well-being of our employees, and our Khan community. This belief is why we have built out a robust Total Rewards package that includes competitive base salaries, and extensive benefits and perks to support physical, mental, and financial well-being.

The compensation band for this role is $77,600 - $87,300 USD annually for candidates based in the United States and $104,862 - $117,969 CAD annually for candidates based in Canada.

The pay range for this position is a general guideline only. The salary offered will depend on internal pay equity and the candidate’s relevant skills, experience, qualifications, and job market data. 

MORE ABOUT US

  • Sal’s TED talk from 2011
  • Sal’s TED talk from 2015
  • Sal's TED talk from 2023
  • Our team:  http://www.khanacademy.org/about/the-team

OUR COMPANY VALUES

Live & breathe learners

We deeply understand and empathize with our users. We leverage user insights, research, and experience to build content, products, services, and experiences that our users trust and love. Our success is defined by the success of our learners and educators.

Take a stand

As a company, we have conviction in our aspirational point of view of how education will evolve. The work we do is in service to moving towards that point of view. However, we also listen, learn and flex in the face of new data, and commit to evolving this point of view as the industry and our users evolve.

Embrace diverse perspectives

We are a diverse community. We seek out and embrace a diversity of voices, perspectives and life experiences leading to stronger, more inclusive teams and better outcomes. As individuals, we are committed to bringing up tough topics and leaning into different points of view with curiosity. We actively listen, learn and collaborate to gain a shared understanding. When a decision is made, we commit to moving forward as a united team.

Work responsibly and sustainably

We understand that achieving our audacious mission is a marathon, so we set realistic timelines and we focus on delivery that also links to the bigger picture. As a non-profit, we are supported by the generosity of donors as well as strategic partners, and understand our responsibility to our finite resources. We spend every dollar as though it were our own. We are responsible for the impact we have on the world and to each other. We ensure our team and company stay healthy and financially sustainable.

Bring out the joy

We are committed to making learning a joyful process. This informs what we build for our users and the culture we co-create with our teammates, partners and donors.

Cultivate learning mindset

We believe in the power of growth for learners and for ourselves. We constantly learn and teach to improve our offerings, ourselves, and our organization. We learn from our mistakes and aren’t afraid to fail. We don't let past failures or successes stop us from taking future bold action and achieving our goals.

Deliver wow

We insist on high standards and deliver delightful, effective end-to-end experiences that our users can rely on. We choose to focus on fewer things — each of which aligns to our ambitious vision — so we can deliver high-quality experiences that accelerate positive measurable learning with our strategic partners.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or Veteran status. We value diversity, equity, and inclusion, and we encourage candidates from historically underrepresented groups to apply.

As part of this commitment, Khan Academy will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations for the hiring process. If reasonable accommodation is needed, please contact careers@khanacademy.org

title: Designer
description:
We invite you to come grow with us.

Inizio Ignite is the global advisory partner for health and life sciences, bringing together connected expertise across Research Partnership, Putnam, Vynamic and STEM. Guided by purpose, passion and precision, we connect insight, strategy and execution to help clients make stronger decisions, accelerate performance and deliver lasting impact for patients. Data, technology and AI enhance this work, alongside the human expertise and judgement that define our advisory offer.

About the India Design Studio

We are establishing an India Design Studio in Gurugram to support Inizio Ignite's global teams. The studio will operate as a central design hub, working with business-unit spokes across Research Partnership, Putnam, Vynamic, STEM and Innovation & Growth.

The Design Studio will turn complex strategic, scientific and commercial content into clear, persuasive client stories. It will support high-value business development and client-facing work, including proposals, RFP responses, pitch decks, credentials, case studies, thought leadership and other priority materials.

Our goal is to improve the quality, speed and consistency of these materials; strengthen how Ignite presents its connected expertise; and build reusable design assets and ways of working that support client delivery and growth.

How quality works in the studio

Quality is shared. Everyone who creates or edits work is accountable for the accuracy and quality of their contribution. Designers complete a structured self-check before handover. The Production & QA Assistant provides independent, checklist-based review and delivery control. The Senior Designer provides creative oversight and final design sign-off for priority or high-risk work. Business stakeholders remain accountable for factual content, client requirements and final business approval.

 

How we use AI

Approved AI and automation tools may be used to support brief understanding, content structuring, asset discovery, layout exploration, tagging and quality checks. They are enabling tools rather than substitutes for design craft. Human judgement, confidentiality, accessibility, brand integrity and final accountability always come first.

 

Your primary role

Designer - India Design Studio

This role is a developing presentation designer who delivers high-quality, client-facing work within agreed standards and timelines. You will improve the clarity, structure and visual impact of proposals, RFP responses, pitch decks and related materials, while building the judgement and independence required to progress in the team.

What you will do

  • Design and redesign slides, proposal sections, RFP materials, credentials and case studies to improve clarity, visual hierarchy, structure and readability.
  • Apply Inizio Ignite brand standards, PowerPoint templates, visual systems and document standards consistently.
  • Translate clear briefs and developed content into polished visual outputs, escalating gaps or ambiguity early.
  • Adapt existing materials for different audiences, clients, geographies and pursuit contexts.
  • Create reusable slides, diagrams, icons and data visuals.
  • Work with the design team and the Senior Designer on more complex visual storytelling and priority pursuits.
  • Own the quality of your work, complete the studio self-check and resolve issues identified through design review or independent QA.
  • Maintain clean, editable, accessible, well-named and version-controlled files that are ready for handover and reuse.
  • Use approved AI tools responsibly where they improve understanding, exploration or efficiency, while applying independent design judgement to every output.
  • Contribute to asset tagging, template improvement, knowledge capture and shared ways of working.

About you

Your skills and experience

  • Around 2-4 years of experience in presentation design, graphic design, visual design or a similar role, ideally supporting proposals, pitches, RFPs or other client-facing materials.
  • A portfolio that demonstrates strong layout, visual hierarchy, slide design, brand application and the ability to make complex content easier to understand.
  • Strong PowerPoint skills and working knowledge of Adobe Creative Cloud, Figma or comparable design tools; Think-cell or other charting experience would be useful.
  • Good understanding of typography, templates, design systems, iconography, data visualisation and document polish.
  • Clear communication skills and the confidence to ask focused questions when briefs, priorities or source content are incomplete.
  • High attention to detail and the ability to manage several workstreams within agreed service levels.
  • Practical AI literacy and the judgement to review, refine or reject AI-assisted suggestions before use.
  • Experience with healthcare, life sciences, consulting or professional-services content would be advantageous.

Ideal profile

  • You enjoy turning rough or inconsistent content into clear, polished and client-ready materials.
  • You can work confidently within templates while bringing creativity, clarity and visual thinking.
  • You seek feedback, learn quickly and take increasing ownership as your skills develop.
  • You are collaborative, dependable and motivated to help build a new global design capability.

Career progression

This role sits within the Design Studio career framework of Production & QA Assistant, a Design team and Senior Designer. Progression to the next level is based on stronger independent ownership, visual storytelling, stakeholder management, delivery of more complex work and contribution to studio standards - not tenure alone.

 Life at Inizio Ignite

You will join a connected, global business where collaboration, curiosity, drive and agility shape how we work. We encourage people to bring their authentic selves, keep learning, challenge the status quo and do the right thing.

In the Design Studio, you will have the opportunity to help build a new capability, work with international teams and influence how Ignite presents its expertise to clients.

We provide

  • A learning culture with opportunities to develop design, technology, AI and healthcare knowledge.
  • International collaboration across Research Partnership, Putnam, Vynamic, STEM and wider Inizio teams.
  • A supportive, inclusive and friendly working environment where your contribution matters.
  • A visible career framework, supported by regular feedback, skills development and opportunities to take on greater complexity and responsibility.

Further information

This is a full-time role and is expected to follow a hybrid working pattern, based at our Inizio location in Gurugram. The role will support global teams across time zones, so flexibility to work within agreed UK- and US-aligned collaboration windows may be required. The exact reporting line, working pattern and hours will be confirmed during the recruitment process.

 

Don't meet every job requirement? That's okay! Our company is dedicated to building an inclusive and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role, but your experience doesn't perfectly fit every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this role or others.

title: Data Engineer, Data Quality & Provenance
description:
About us   

Founded in 2017, Wayve is the leading developer of Embodied AI technology.  Our advanced AI software and foundation models enable vehicles to perceive, understand, and navigate any complex environment, enhancing the usability and safety of automated driving systems.

Our vision is to create autonomy that propels the world forward.  Our intelligent, mapless, and hardware-agnostic AI products are designed for automakers, accelerating the transition from assisted to automated driving. 

In our fast-paced environment big problems ignite us—we embrace uncertainty, leaning into complex challenges to unlock groundbreaking solutions. We aim high and stay humble in our pursuit of excellence, constantly learning and evolving as we pave the way for a smarter, safer future.

At Wayve, your contributions matter.  We value diversity, embrace new perspectives, and foster an inclusive work environment; we back each other to deliver impact.  

Make Wayve the experience that defines your career!  

The role

As a Data Engineer focused on Data Quality & Provenance, you will build the data foundation that enables Wayve’s autonomous-driving development. You’ll turn vast volumes of fleet and simulation data into trusted, discoverable and reproducible datasets that ML, autonomy, simulation and safety teams can use with confidence. This is a high-impact opportunity to define the data products, standards and operating model behind embodied intelligence at petabyte scale.

Key responsibilities:

  • Design, build and operate scalable batch and streaming pipelines for multimodal fleet and simulation data.
  • Create data models, catalogs, indexes and query capabilities that make sensor, vehicle-state, map and event data easy to discover and use.
  • Build versioned, reproducible datasets for training, evaluation, replay, scenario mining and safety analysis.
  • Develop robust workflows for data ingestion, synchronisation, transformation, curation, labelling and data-quality validation.
  • Partner with autonomy, ML, simulation and safety engineers to define schemas, APIs and data contracts.
  • Establish strong standards for lineage, observability, access controls, retention and cost management across the data platform.
  • Improve the performance, reliability and unit economics of large-scale storage and compute workloads.

About you

In order to set you up for success as a Data Engineer, Data Quality & Provenance at Wayve, we’re looking for the following skills and experience.

Essential

  • Strong hands-on Python and SQL skills, with solid production software-engineering fundamentals.
  • Experience designing and operating large-scale distributed data systems, beyond small-scale analytics or reporting pipelines.
  • Hands-on experience with distributed processing and workflow orchestration technologies, such as Spark, Flyte, Airflow or equivalent tools.
  • Experience building and operating cloud-based data platforms using object storage, including data organisation, versioning, querying, governance and cost management.
  • Proven ownership of data quality, lineage, observability, reproducibility and incident response for production data workflows.
  • Experience translating ambiguous requirements from ML, data-science, robotics or similarly technical teams into durable, reusable platform capabilities.
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity and helping define the boundaries, standards and ways of working for a growing data platform.

Desirable

  • Experience in autonomous vehicles, ADAS, robotics, mapping, drones or another sensor-rich domain.
  • Familiarity with time-synchronised sensor data, geospatial data, or multimodal datasets.
  • Understanding of ML training, evaluation, simulation or closed-loop development workflows.

This is a full-time role based in our office in Leonburg, Germany.  At Wayve we want the best of all worlds so we operate a hybrid working policy that combines time together in our offices and workshops to fuel innovation, culture, relationships and learning, and time spent working from home.  

Wayve is committed to creating an inclusive interview experience. If you require any accommodations or adjustments to participate fully in our interview process, please let us know.

We understand that everyone has a unique set of skills and experiences and that not everyone will meet all of the requirements listed above. If you’re passionate about self-driving cars and think you have what it takes to make a positive impact on the world, we encourage you to apply.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition  (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.  

For more information visit Careers at Wayve. 

To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve 

For US candidates only, please visit E-Verify Notice and Participation and Right to Work

title: Product Manager, Platform
description: We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era. When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done. Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma. We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today. ROLE OVERVIEW AI is only as good as the data underneath it. Schemas is the configuration layer where customers model their scientific data and processes. It's the customer-defined data model that makes Benchling different from a point solution, and the contract every other system (internal apps, integrations, AI agents) relies on when reading or writing to Benchling. Get it right, and AI inherits a solid foundation; get it wrong, every layer above inherits the problem. As Schemas PM, you own the primitives (schema types, computed fields, fieldsets, constraints, static properties, data versioning) that every other team at Benchling builds on top of. This is one of the highest-leverage, most technically interesting roles on the platform team, and one we're investing in now as AI features across Benchling increasingly depend on the quality of the underlying data model. RESPONSIBILITIES Set product direction for Schemas and ship toward it incrementally, balancing fast prototyping with the platform stability admins and developers depend on. Relentlessly track how customers use Schemas — where it delights, where it fails — and build sharp personas and job-to-be-done context for each user type (admins, scientists, computational teams, internal and external developers). Bring customer "why," not just feature requests, back to Engineering and Design; partner with them closely to ship new capabilities. Champion structured, well-modeled data as the foundation for AI value across Benchling, anticipating what schema consumers will need next. Partner with Customer Experience, Field, Sales, and Marketing to get customer signal into the roadmap early. Partner closely with other Platform and Apps PMs — schemas underpin nearly every other platform surface, so alignment on sequencing and shared abstractions matters as much as your own roadmap. QUALIFICATIONS Energized by platform work and systems thinking; comfortable building the right abstraction ahead of need. Has designed, owned, or significantly evolved a data-modeling, schema, or configuration system used by external developers or technical admins — not just consumed one as a feature. Becomes the go-to person for customers, field, and engineers — not a router to engineering. Deep, demonstrated discovery practice: has built personas and JTBD frameworks from scratch, not just used ones handed to them. Track record balancing long-term vision with incremental shipping. Strong communicator across technical and executive audiences; B2B SaaS or developer-platform background preferred. Genuine curiosity about the science behind the data. You don't need a science background, but you should want one by the end of your first quarter here. HOW WE WORK Flexible Hybrid Work: We offer a flexible hybrid work arrangement that prioritizes in-office collaboration. Employees are expected to be on-site Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. #LI-EK1 Benchling welcomes everyone. We believe diversity enriches our team so we hire people with a wide range of identities, backgrounds, and experiences. We are an equal opportunity employer. That means we don’t discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We also consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law, including but not limited to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

description:

Real Chemistry is seeking a Coordinator, Events and Partnerships to help deliver thoughtful, well-organized events and partnership programs that strengthen our brand, thought leadership, and business priorities. Reporting to the Associate Director, Events and Partnerships, this entry-level role provides hands-on coordination across live, virtual, and hybrid programs, sponsorships, and partner activations.

The Coordinator will support the details that keep programs moving, including timelines, attendee and speaker logistics, vendor coordination, materials, tracking, and post-event follow-up. This is a strong opportunity for someone who is highly organized, detail-oriented, collaborative, and eager to build a career in events, partnerships, and marketing within a fast-moving healthcare environment.

What You’ll Do

Support Event Planning and Execution

  • Support the planning and delivery of US-based live, virtual, and hybrid events, including owned programs, sponsorships, receptions, panels, webinars, and conference activations.
  • Coordinate event logistics such as schedules, workback plans, attendee lists, registration details, venue and vendor information, speaker materials, signage, shipping, and on-site needs.
  • Help prepare event briefs, run-of-show documents, checklists, contact sheets, and other materials that enable smooth execution.
  • Provide on-site or virtual event support as assigned, including registration, room readiness, speaker support, materials management, and real-time troubleshooting.
  • Complete assigned tasks accurately and on time, escalating risks, changes, or missing information to the Associate Director.

Coordinate Partnerships and Sponsorship Deliverables

  • Support the execution of partnership and sponsorship commitments by tracking deliverables, deadlines, approvals, asset requirements, and fulfillment status.
  • Coordinate routine communications and follow-ups with event organizers, partners, vendors, and internal stakeholders under the direction of the Associate Director.
  • Collect and organize contracts, invoices, vendor forms, creative specifications, speaker information, and other required documentation.
  • Help ensure sponsorship assets and benefits are delivered accurately and consistently with Real Chemistry brand standards.

Collaborate Across Marketing and the Business

  • Work closely with Marketing and Communications, Marketing Operations, content and creative teams, Capability Area leaders, and other internal partners to coordinate event-related inputs and deliverables.
  • Schedule planning meetings, prepare agendas, capture notes and action items, and follow up with owners to keep workstreams moving.
  • Support the development and routing of event communications, invitations, promotional materials, speaker content, and internal updates.
  • Respond to routine stakeholder questions and direct more complex requests or strategic decisions to the Associate Director.

Maintain Tracking, Budgets, and Reporting

  • Maintain accurate event calendars, project trackers, timelines, attendee lists, partner deliverable trackers, and shared files.
  • Assist with budget administration by organizing estimates, purchase information, invoices, expense codes, and reconciliation materials for review.
  • Compile attendance, engagement, lead generation, and other available performance data for post-event recaps and reporting.
  • Help gather feedback, document learnings, and update templates and checklists to improve future programs.
  • Follow established processes for file management, approvals, brand compliance, and vendor coordination.

This Role Is a Good Fit If You

  • Are energized by events and enjoy turning many small details into a seamless experience.
  • Are highly organized, dependable, and comfortable managing multiple assignments and deadlines.
  • Communicate clearly and professionally with colleagues, vendors, partners, and event participants.
  • Have strong attention to detail and take pride in accurate, complete, and polished work.
  • Are proactive about asking questions, surfacing issues, and learning new processes and tools.
  • Enjoy collaborating across teams and can adapt calmly when priorities or event needs change.
  • Are willing to travel and work occasional early mornings, evenings, or weekends when event schedules require it.

What You Should Have

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 0–2 years of experience in events, marketing, communications, project coordination, or a related area. Relevant internships, campus leadership, volunteer experience, or part-time roles may count toward experience.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to follow detailed processes and manage overlapping deadlines.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills and confidence interacting professionally with internal and external partners.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications, including Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, and Excel.
  • Ability to travel for events as needed and to lift or move event materials within reasonable workplace guidelines.
  • Interest in healthcare, life sciences, marketing, communications, or professional services is preferred.
  • Experience supporting events, conferences, student organizations, hospitality programs, vendors, or sponsorship deliverables is preferred.

 

Pay Range: $30-$34 per hour

title: Partner Development Manager, AI Partnerships
description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Worldwide Alliances and Channels team develops and manages partnerships that help businesses adopt Stripe’s payments and financial infrastructure. These partnerships create new routes to customers, extend the reach of Stripe’s Sales teams, and help Stripe and its partners serve shared customers.

The role sits on the Americas Alliances and Channels Tech Partnerships team. The team builds and executes joint go-to-market initiatives with major technology companies, with the goal of accelerating Stripe’s commercial growth.

As part of this team, you’ll lead global partnerships across the artificial intelligence ecosystem, with an initial emphasis on leading AI labs. You’ll work across Sales, Marketing, Product, Solutions Architecture, and regional partnerships teams to develop shared opportunities and turn them into scalable global partner strategies.

What you’ll do

As a Partner Development Manager, you’ll define and build Stripe’s global partnerships across the artificial intelligence ecosystem, initially focusing on leading AI labs. Although the role sits on the Americas Alliances and Channels Tech Partnerships team, its mandate is global. You’ll establish relationships across partner organizations, develop shared value propositions, and translate early opportunities into joint commercial and product initiatives.

This is an opportunity to build a new partnership motion from the ground up. You’ll start with focused opportunities, determine what works, and create a playbook that Stripe’s regional teams can apply around the world. Your work will span co-selling, co-marketing, and co-building.

Responsibilities

  • Build senior relationships across the commercial, partnerships, product, and technical organizations of Stripe’s priority AI partners
  • Develop and execute global partner strategies, including shared value propositions, joint business plans, success measures, and operating cadences
  • Identify and launch co-selling, co-marketing, and co-building initiatives that create value for Stripe, its partners, and shared customers
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams across Sales, Marketing, Product, Solutions Architecture, Legal, Finance, and regional partnerships
  • Work with Product and technical teams to identify opportunities for product collaboration and support productive technical conversations with partners
  • Create repeatable partnership playbooks that regional teams can adapt for local markets and AI ecosystems
  • Assess partnership performance, identify opportunities and risks, and communicate progress clearly to senior stakeholders

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 8 or more years of experience in strategic partnerships, partner development, business development, or a related commercial role within technology or another complex business-to-business environment
  • Experience building a strategic technology partnership from its early stages and translating the relationship into joint commercial, go-to-market, or product outcomes
  • Experience developing and executing joint go-to-market plans with external partners and cross-functional Sales, Marketing, Product, or technical teams
  • Experience building relationships with senior external stakeholders and leading global or distributed teams through influence
  • Bachelor’s degree and willingness to travel

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience managing partnerships with artificial intelligence companies, cloud providers, data platforms, developer platforms, or other global technology ecosystems
  • Understanding of the artificial intelligence and data value chain, including the commercial and technical considerations involved in building partner ecosystems
  • Experience across co-selling, co-marketing, and product or technical collaboration
  • Experience developing a partnership framework or playbook that was adopted across multiple regions or teams
  • Experience in payments, financial infrastructure, financial services, or commerce
